note: THE SHIPPED MOODPACK - an empty pack on purpose. THE BOOK at src/moods/moods.json is the shipped list of colours; this file is the same shape as a module that can be LOADED beside it: moods folded in over the book, marked as coming from the pack, taken out again by UNLOAD without the book being touched. Load a pack of your own with LOAD MOODPACK in the MOOD panel (or /moodpack load) - a .json file holding {moods:[{id,label,rule}]} - and it layers over this one. Nothing here is handed to her until it is loaded.
